extension.description: Browse and play audiobooks and podcasts from your AudioBookShelf server.
extension.news: v0.19.0 Sleep timer with screen dimming and volume ramp-down. Set a duration (5/10/15/30/45/60/90 min, end-of-chapter, or custom) from the new "Sleep timer" entry in the root menu while playing. While the timer is active, Kodi's screensaver is swapped for a black/dim mode that kicks in after a shorter idle window; volume fades to zero in the last N seconds (default 30); on expiry, playback stops and (optionally, CEC only) the display is sent to standby.
